description: This file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecordService class, which provides methods for managing employee immigration records, including retrieval, saving, deletion, and searching of records within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordService
classes.description: Service class providing business logic for managing employee immigration records, including CRUD operations and search capabilities.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao instance used for data access.

methods.name: setEmployeeImmigrationRecordDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeImmigrationRecordDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee immigration record based on employee number and record number.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all immigration records for a given employee.

methods.name: saveEmployeeImmigrationRecord
methods.description: Saves the provided EmployeeImmigrationRecord to the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Deletes specified immigration records for an employee based on sequence numbers.

methods.name: searchEmployeeImmigrationRecords
methods.description: Searches for immigration records matching the given filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeImmigrationRecordsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of immigration records matching the search filter.
